rule: Per-part angular velocity must be <= 45 deg/frame (angle-unwrapped, short way) on every adjacent clip pair, including the walk loop seam, except (1) the named frames below and (2) any frame whose smear raster overlaps an arm part. Off-hand must stay on the haft within 1 px / 2 deg except after the knockout floor release, and except the named off_hand frames below.

exceptions.label: inbetween
exceptions.reason: pendulum→low arm-basin flip. Joint-space in-betweens sweep the visor; a visor-clear path needs more frames than the 56-frame attack cap.

exceptions.label: inbetween
exceptions.reason: back→rise. A joint-lerp mid puts 35 px of the haft on the visor; in-place off-hand relock jumps the next frame by ~80°. Hidden under the backswing smear when one is generated.

exceptions.label: breakdown:whip
exceptions.reason: coil→whip basin flip, hidden under the whip strike smear (one-frame flip / smear trick).

exceptions.label: inbetween
exceptions.reason: overshoot→idle basin return. The visor-clear repair added far more than 6 frames; dropped to keep v003.2 recovery timing.

exceptions.label: key:idle
exceptions.reason: second frame of the same overshoot→idle basin return (see frame 54).

exceptions.label: inbetween
exceptions.reason: idle→hit_react forearm snap (the v003.2 f13 spike, now at the start of the clip). A clean path needs 5 in-betweens; this clip may only grow by 2 frames.
